why: Setting up an agent tool's refusals: its first install on the person's own message, its key given to its own login, its account sign-in, and the person's ask to a secretary to set one up. Each needs an agent tool on the PATH the office's terminals get, which here would be this computer's real tools, or a sandbox, or the person's proved message, or registered secretaries. They are met through their doors with made-up tools on a made-up PATH in the tests named for them, such as tests/a-key-reaches-the-tools-own-login-on-stdin-only.test.ts and tests/the-set-up-press-asks-one-secretary-in-the-persons-words.test.ts.
